podcast.body: An album by Quincy Jones where he hired the Brothers Johnson to play, who were still commercially unknown at the time. The Brothers Johnson ended up contributing four songs to the LP, including "Is It Love That We're Missing," which reached number 18 on the R&B chart, marking Quincy's highest charting hit to date under his own name. "The Brothers wound up contributing four songs to the LP, including Is It Love That Were Missing, which reached number 18 on the R&B chart, Quincy's highest charting hit to date under his own name."
